product_name: USGS Mars 2020 TRN HiRISE DTM mosaic, Jezero crater, 1 m/px
bounds_units: meters in the source CRS (pixel edges)

orientation.row_0: row 0 = SOUTH edge of the strip; +row = +y = north
orientation.col_0: col 0 = WEST edge of the strip; +col = +x = east
orientation.flip: the raster's native row 0 is north; the window was flipped vertically (np.flipud) before saving
orientation.sample_positions: sample [i, j] is the pixel centered at x = west + (j + 0.5) * pixel_size_x, y = south + (i + 0.5) * pixel_size_y

estimated_bytes_method: rows_touched x full_row_width x 4 bytes (striped float32, one block per scanline)

line.name: jezero_floor
line.note: center row of the strip is the 2D demo's jezero_floor line (row index rows_y // 2)
